correctness.rationale: For every odd n and integer w>=2, the inverse of A=I+wS is an alternating polynomial in S divided by 1+w^n. Its coordinate numerators for b in [1,w]^n have sharp integer bounds 1 and w^n, forcing 0<alpha<1. These w^n vectors plus origin exhaust all det(A) fractional representatives. The affine lattice cuts them by sum(b) mod (w+1), giving the exact complete numerator and normalized index. At q=ceil(n/(w+1))>=2 the degree-one coefficient vanishes; removing integer barycentric parts proves all lower-degree decompositions, and the first positive residue representative yields a nondecomposable integer point at q. Exact standard-library enumeration verified 3686 representatives and independent lattice counts at 32 parameter/dilation pairs, plus symmetry and volume.

value.rationale: The full h*-polynomial is an intrinsic and motivated invariant of the natural family singled out by a current weighted graph IDP classification. The exact first failure determines all preceding normality degrees, a genuine strengthening of the known binary nonnormality statement, and fixed weight two yields an unbounded delayed failure as dimension grows. The family and grading are natural, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
